mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the least-privilege fact lets the model build an instance where an applicant-only caller succeeds on PatchStatus, which the LeastPrivilege predicate must catch via the permission matrix.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilegeViolation { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Success and op.kind = PatchStatus and op.caller.roles = Applicant and Officer not in op.caller.roles }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the append-only chain fact lets the model produce two distinct initial entries (or branched chain) for the same application, which the AppendOnly predicate must reject.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj e1, e2: AuditEntry | e1.application = e2.application and no e1.prev and no e2.prev }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the no-self-assignment fact lets the model assign an application's applicant as its own assigned officer, which NoSelfMutation must reject.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfAssignmentViolation { some a: LoanApplication | a.assignedOfficer = a.applicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the no-self-decision-in-audit fact lets an officer-actor audit entry exist whose actor equals the application's applicant, violating FR-013.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_SelfDecisionViolation { some e: AuditEntry | e.actorRole = Officer and e.actor = e.application.applicant }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the byte-equivalent-not-found fact lets the model emit a 403 PermissionDenied on a GET, which leaks existence; NoInformationLeakage and FR-020/021 must catch this.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeakViaForbidden { some op: Operation | op.kind = GetApplication and op.authenticated = TrueB and op.outcome = PermissionDenied403 }

mutation_targets.rationale: Clearing the audit-completeness fact lets the model produce an application with no audit entry, violating the invariant that every state change has a corresponding audit record.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MissingAuditEntry { some a: LoanApplication | no application.a }
